title: Coffee shop in the themepark. Anyone been there?
content: It looks exactly like a Starbucks. This is the first time I dreamed about this place. It seems to be located within the themepark area. It also has 3 floors. It also seems like I'm working there as the manager. I have never had a job within the mall world. But here I was running this place. The other employees were all women. At any given time, I think I saw about 3 to 5 women wandering around the place. The dream started with me entering the place. I was walking with a woman who was dressed in a business suit. She looked important. she had long straight black hair, maybe it was dark brown and had bangs. We walked all the way up to the 3rd floor. I had this feeling that we were in some kind of relationship. She made her way to a door, opened it and went into an office and closed the door behind her. This was the last time I saw her in the dream. The 3rd floor was empty. Nothing up here but wooden walls and floors. a couple of small rooms and a large office. I went back downstairs and every time someone walked in, I was able to look outside and see the themepark. I could see a rollercoaster, a carousel, and several other rides. There were hot dog, popcorn and cotton candy vendors out there as well. I never stepped foot out of the coffee shop. It was also noisy out there. The sounds of children laughing and having fun. The main floor was wide open with tables and chairs spread out. A few people were hanging out here. The walls had wooden paneling. There were also stairs that seem to lead all the way out to the rooftop. A woman walked in and it seemed like she was my girlfriend. We ended up going to the 2nd floor and sitting down on a large comfy recliner. I don't remember exactly what we did or talked about but I do remember what the 2nd floor looked like. The 2nd floor looked like a study. Tons of book shelfs with tons of books. It was very relaxed up there. The walls were all wooden paneling. there were old lamps on the wall. There also seem to be about 3 of these large recliners along with a two small sofas and coffee tables. There was also a model railroad train and track that went all around the upper walls of the room. there were these small streams of water that ran along the bookshelves. toy boats would float around them. After a while the place got crowded with children. They were just running around and making a mess. Destroying stuff. I could hear the employees downstairs yelling at them to go away. But they would not listen. I told the woman I was with I had to go and do something. i went downstairs and started yelling that I was closing the place for the day. I yelled at everyone to get out or else. I don't know what I meant by that, but it worked. Everyone left. Once everyone was gone everyone, including myself, started to clean up the place. There were people at the door trying to get in and I was yelling at them to go away, the place was closed. The woman I was with said she would see me later and left. I gave the option to the employees if they wanted to close for the day or reopen and continue. They chose to reopen and continue for the day. I opened the doors again and looked outside. I could now see that beyond the themepark, there was an ocean. There were a few sailboats out there and what looked like a cruiseship. I went back up to the 3rd floor and went into the office. It was empty and, for some reason, I got bad vibes about being in there. Anyone seen a Starbucks like place around the amusement park/theme park area that looks like that one I was working at? It was the first time I was even there.
